issue.title: Command Mode report rows with a preview-first policy refuse Ctrl+Enter and command-chip runs
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-nu.4.1.1 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by the bob-cli-nu.4.1 land agent.

Root cause (bob-plugins, plugin bob-command-mode): the runner's preview-first guard
(`src/060-runner.js:138`, `policy === "preview-first" && usePreview !== true && !opts.skipGuards`
returns "Run the preview first, then apply.") fires for report-presentation rows, because
the sheet report path and the chip engine's `runText`/`openText` report stage call
`runner.run` without `skipGuards`. Non-report run paths pass `skipGuards` when no confirm
guard applies (`src/090-plugin.js:533`, `src/078-api-chip-contract.js:249`,
`src/065-sequence-runner.js:110`), so only the report presentation is affected.

No current bob catalog entry combines a report presentation with a `preview-first`
policy, so nothing is broken today; the first such entry would be un-runnable from
Ctrl+Enter in the Command Mode sheet and from a `run:` command chip click.

Fix: decide whether the report path should pass `skipGuards` when no confirm guard
applies (matching the run path), then add a regression covering a report +
preview-first row through the sheet's Ctrl+Enter and `api.commandMode.runText`.

issue.creation_reason: A command-chip engine phase found that the report run path never skips the preview-first guard; it is latent today but would block the first such catalog entry.
